remarks: Fabulous location 120' wide x 100' deep mostly cleared fully buildable lot in the beautiful, ,fast growing, Lake Erie Beach district of Angola. If you are looking for even more, we also have 2 more lots adjoining this one, for sale, on the back side on Eisenhower. They are 340 Eisenhower ( 120' x 100' ), and 336 Eisenhower ( 100' x 100' ). You could break 340 Eisenhower 1/2 to create 2 buildable lots as well.
